subject.title: fix: use atomic writes for crash-safety on exec approvals, restart sentinel, shell profile, and saveJsonFile

question: Should the remaining shell-completion profile creation/update path switch to `writeTextAtomic` with `0o644`, or should direct profile writes stay because of profile symlink or permission compatibility concerns?
rationale: Atomic replacement of user shell startup files can change inode, symlink, and permission behavior, and the issue is already routed with maintainer-review/no-new-fix-pr labels.

options.title: Approve narrow atomic profile writes
options.body: Use `writeTextAtomic` for missing-profile creation and updated-profile replacement, preserve standard profile mode, and add focused completion-runtime tests.

options.title: Keep direct profile writes
options.body: Accept the remaining crash-safety gap if maintainers prefer not to atomically replace user-managed shell profile files.

options.title: Defer to completion-profile redesign
options.body: Keep this issue open until profile path resolution and profile mutation semantics are redesigned together.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow atomic profile writes
recommendation.body: Use `writeTextAtomic` for missing-profile creation and updated-profile replacement, preserve standard profile mode, and add focused completion-runtime tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history places this person on both completion-runtime refactoring and restart-sentinel persistence work relevant to this review.
